propositions: _fold_heads currently merges bundle heads into the worktree HEAD using git merge, making the heal result dependent on the currently checked-out branch, and _require_tracker_on_ref refuses the heal when current_branch != ref, preventing healing of off-branch and detached-HEAD trackers.
The fold must be rewritten to fold heads into refs/heads/<ref>'s tip using git merge-tree --write-tree and git commit-tree, independent of which branch is checked out.
Publishing the merged result must use git update-ref for off-branch refs and git reset --hard for the checked-out branch, maintaining worktree consistency without blanket refusal of off-branch heals.
A narrow pre-download guard must replace _require_tracker_on_ref: refuse only when ref IS checked out and the worktree is dirty, allowing off-branch and detached-HEAD trackers to heal.
The fold must preserve merge=ours policy for .bridge_state collisions, with regression test coverage proving merge-tree honors the driver identically to git merge.
Off-branch heals must not move the checked-out branch tip or modify the worktree, while on-branch heals must leave git status --porcelain empty.
